decision_paths.KEEP: Retain an explicitly load-bearing or protocol-preserving item when removal or relocation fails the independent oracle.
decision_paths.DEFER: Move explicitly superseded context behind the bounded use boundary when the paired replay preserves quality.
decision_paths.PRUNE: Candidate only when the exact paired removal preserves all deterministic quality and collateral-change checks.
decision_paths.RELOCATE_CANDIDATE: Candidate only when the paired relocation preserves explicit protocol/dependency order and quality.
decision_paths.COMPRESS_CANDIDATE: Not tested by this seed; no compression semantics or positive result is fabricated.
decision_paths.DO_NOTHING: Use for no-op, ambiguous, unsafe, or insufficiently evidenced cases.

scenarios.task_environment_concept: Complete a deterministic profile update while an unrelated context block is present.

intervention_variants.exact_transformation: Remove only context_block_id=ctx_irrelevant; preserve all action/result IDs and initial state.
intervention_variants.expected_structural_effect: One context block absent; no referenced event or state transition changes.

scenarios.quality_oracle: Final state equals baseline on the task predicate and all prohibited-collateral predicates.
scenarios.negative_control: Keep an otherwise identical baseline/control pair to detect fixture drift.
scenarios.privacy_license_status: self-authored deterministic fixture; no third-party content

scenarios.task_environment_concept: Use an inventory result to complete a bounded checkout operation.

intervention_variants.exact_transformation: Remove result_inventory from the later action context without changing the environment.
intervention_variants.expected_structural_effect: The checkout action lacks its explicit input/result reference.

scenarios.quality_oracle: Variant fails the checkout completion predicate or violates the explicit action/result invariant; baseline must remain PASS.
scenarios.negative_control: Replay the baseline with the result retained and require the same final state hash.
scenarios.privacy_license_status: self-authored deterministic fixture; no third-party content

scenarios.task_environment_concept: Apply policy version 2 while policy version 1 is explicitly superseded.

intervention_variants.exact_transformation: Move ctx_policy_v1 behind the bounded action boundary; do not remove policy_v2.
intervention_variants.expected_structural_effect: Superseded context is no longer before action_apply; current policy remains in place.

scenarios.quality_oracle: Final policy state and completion predicate equal baseline; no pre-action use of policy_v1 is required.
scenarios.negative_control: A variant that moves policy_v2 behind action_apply must fail the protocol predicate.
scenarios.privacy_license_status: self-authored deterministic fixture; no third-party content

scenarios.task_environment_concept: Read a generated identifier and use it in a later update action.

intervention_variants.exact_transformation: Remove result_created from the later action's bounded context.
intervention_variants.expected_structural_effect: The later action loses its explicit generated-identifier input.

scenarios.quality_oracle: Variant fails the exact target-identifier predicate; baseline completes with the created identifier.
scenarios.negative_control: Change only the non-required audit observation and require the create/update state to remain unchanged.
scenarios.privacy_license_status: self-authored deterministic fixture; no third-party content

scenarios.task_environment_concept: Record an audit result that is not read by any later action and has no state effect.

intervention_variants.exact_transformation: Remove result_audit from the later context while retaining the audit action's source record outside planner input.
intervention_variants.expected_structural_effect: An unreferenced result is absent from the planner-visible context; environment state is unchanged.

scenarios.quality_oracle: Final task state and invariant set are equal to baseline; audit result is not a task input.
scenarios.negative_control: A synthetic relation added to result_audit is forbidden; this control ensures adjacency is not promoted to dependency.
scenarios.privacy_license_status: self-authored deterministic fixture; no third-party content

scenarios.task_environment_concept: Create, authorize, and commit a state change through a three-step explicit chain.

intervention_variants.exact_transformation: Remove the middle authorization result or reorder commit before authorization.
intervention_variants.expected_structural_effect: At least one explicit dependency or protocol edge is violated.

scenarios.quality_oracle: Variant fails the final committed-state predicate or protocol invariant; baseline commits exactly once.
scenarios.negative_control: A control retains all three actions and checks stable state transitions under the same seed.
scenarios.privacy_license_status: self-authored deterministic fixture; no third-party content

scenarios.task_environment_concept: Relocate a stable reference block within the same protocol-safe pre-action zone.

intervention_variants.exact_transformation: Move ctx_reference to another position before action_execute without changing content hash or state revision.
intervention_variants.expected_structural_effect: Position changes; all explicit protocol and state constraints remain true.

scenarios.quality_oracle: Final state, action arguments, and invariant checks equal baseline.
scenarios.negative_control: Relocate the same block after action_execute and require the protocol-failure control to be rejected.
scenarios.privacy_license_status: self-authored deterministic fixture; no third-party content

scenarios.task_environment_concept: Attempt to move a handshake or authorization context after the action that requires it.

intervention_variants.expected_structural_effect: The explicit protocol_precedes edge is false in the variant.

scenarios.quality_oracle: Variant fails the protocol/authorization predicate before accepting the action; baseline remains PASS.
scenarios.negative_control: The safe-zone relocation in S07 is not used as evidence for this distinct protocol boundary.
scenarios.privacy_license_status: self-authored deterministic fixture; no third-party content

scenarios.task_environment_concept: The same immutable reference is repeated without a new state revision or later reference.

intervention_variants.exact_transformation: Remove the second block with the identical content hash and no additional reference edge.
intervention_variants.expected_structural_effect: One exact repeated block absent; the first reference remains.

scenarios.quality_oracle: Final state and all task predicates equal baseline; the equality is case-specific, not a general repeat rule.
scenarios.negative_control: S10 uses similar content with distinct identity/state and must not inherit this result.
scenarios.privacy_license_status: self-authored deterministic fixture; no third-party content

scenarios.task_environment_concept: A superficially repeated instruction is re-emitted after a state revision and is required by a later operation.

intervention_variants.exact_transformation: Remove ctx_repeated_2 even though its content hash resembles ctx_repeated_1.
intervention_variants.expected_structural_effect: The later explicit reference is missing; visual/content repetition alone is insufficient.

scenarios.quality_oracle: Variant fails the later operation predicate; baseline succeeds.
scenarios.negative_control: Do not infer load-bearing status from adjacency; retain the explicit later reference as the deciding structural evidence.
scenarios.privacy_license_status: self-authored deterministic fixture; no third-party content

scenarios.task_environment_concept: A minimal context sequence already satisfies the task with no safe intervention target.

intervention_variants.exact_transformation: No transformation; emit an explicit control record with the same canonical trace.
intervention_variants.expected_structural_effect: No structural change and no claimed savings.

scenarios.quality_oracle: Baseline and control have identical final state hashes and oracle PASS.
scenarios.negative_control: Any synthetic deletion is out of scope because no candidate is established.
scenarios.privacy_license_status: self-authored deterministic fixture; no third-party content

scenarios.task_environment_concept: A repeated observation has no explicit reference, dependency, supersession, or state relation establishing safe intervention.

intervention_variants.exact_transformation: No mutation is admitted; a hypothetical removal may be recorded only in evaluation planning and is not fed to the planner.

scenarios.quality_oracle: Baseline must PASS; no variant outcome is used to manufacture a general removable label.
scenarios.negative_control: Timestamp age, adjacency, repetition, and evaluation success must not create a dependency or removability relation.
scenarios.privacy_license_status: self-authored deterministic fixture; no third-party content
